id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_250.pack|cs_: "Sorry, after all I want to save Mia... She's my sister!
"Sorry, Mia... No matter what, I won't leave you alone again.
"Brother turning gold... I don't want that...
"I want to be with you... fighting, laughing, fighting again... compared to such rotten days...
"Being poor is nothing! I can stand cold and hunger! So...
When Mia's tears fell on the cursed necklace, it shattered at once!
"Heh heh... Because of my foolish brother, I'm poor again..."
